title: Archive extraction writes outside the target or expands without bound

evidence.description: Names are reduced to a base name, links, devices and FIFOs are refused, entries are capped at 64 and expansion at a ratio of 500.

title: Third-party GitHub Actions are pinned by mutable tag
description: Workflows reference actions by version tag, which the action owner can move. A compromised tag would run attacker code with the job token and secrets.
root_cause: uses: owner/action@vX.Y.Z instead of a full commit SHA.
intended_behavior: Third-party actions are pinned to a 40-character commit SHA with the version in a trailing comment, as in security-audit.yml.

trace.description: Workflow runs resolve the tag at run time.
The resolved code runs with the job token and secrets.

evidence.description: The step is pinned by tag, not SHA.

conditions.description: Needs the upstream action tag to be moved or its repository compromised.

execution.attacker_perspective: Compromised upstream action maintainer or tag.
instructions: Inspect the workflows: uses lines end in a version tag.
execution.observed_result: The action code is resolved from a movable tag.

remediation.strategy: Pin every action to its commit SHA, keeping the version in a comment.

impact.reason: Only GitHub-published `actions/*` are tag-pinned, which `.claude/rules/ci.md` allows; pinning them is extra hardening.

title: Download URL reaches internal addresses through yt-dlp
description: A user URL is handed to yt-dlp.
claimed_root_cause: A user URL is handed to yt-dlp.

evidence.description: Platform hostname matching, the platform-only extractor allowlist, --ignore-config and `--` are each covered by tests (ssrf_test.go).
